quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a humanity-scale risk coordination platform aligning global institutions around existential challenges.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform provides the shared situational awareness and coordination infrastructure that humanity needs to align global institutions around existential challenges - the missing governance layer between ambition and collective action.
quests.hint: Lead with the missing governance layer.
quests.explanation: Naming the missing governance layer creates the space for a coordination platform that fills the identified gap.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a long-term civilisational planning institute developing century-scale strategic frameworks.
quests.correctAnswer: Our institute develops century-scale strategic frameworks for civilisational challenges - preparing the intellectual and institutional tools that humanity needs to make decisions whose consequences extend to grandchildren we will never meet.
quests.hint: Lead with the grandchildren we will never meet.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren we will never meet is the most visceral expression of long-termist thinking.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an evidence synthesis platform accelerating the translation of scientific research into policy.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform synthesises evidence from thousands of scientific studies into clear policy recommendations in real time - closing the gap between what research shows and what policy does that costs lives and resources every day.
quests.hint: Lead with the gap that costs lives every day.
quests.explanation: Gap that costs lives every day creates urgency that pure academic framing of evidence synthesis never achieves.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a universal vaccine platform technology enabling rapid development against any new pathogen.
quests.correctAnswer: Our universal vaccine platform can be configured to any new pathogen in weeks rather than months - the platform technology that converts pandemic preparedness from a hope into an engineering problem we have already solved.
quests.hint: Lead with an engineering problem already solved.
quests.explanation: Already solved engineering problem is the confidence-building framing that converts pandemic preparedness from aspiration to capability.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a global health intelligence platform integrating surveillance data from every country in real time.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform integrates disease surveillance data from every country into a single real-time global health intelligence picture - giving the WHO and national governments the situational awareness that the next outbreak demands from day one.
quests.hint: Lead with the from day one demand.
quests.explanation: From day one is the operational standard that the next pandemic will demand and that current systems cannot meet.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI-mediated scientific peer review platform reducing publication bias and replication failures.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform uses AI to detect methodological weaknesses publication bias and replication risks before any paper is published - improving the quality and reliability of the scientific literature that policy and medicine depend on.
quests.hint: Lead with what policy and medicine depend on.
quests.explanation: Policy and medicine depend on the scientific literature framing elevates peer review quality from academic to societal importance.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a quantum biology research company investigating quantum effects in photosynthesis and consciousness.
quests.correctAnswer: Our research company investigates quantum coherence effects in biological systems - understanding the quantum mechanisms in photosynthesis bird navigation and potentially consciousness that could open entirely new therapeutic and technological frontiers.
quests.hint: Lead with the entirely new frontiers.
quests.explanation: Entirely new frontiers is the exploration framing that makes fundamental research compelling beyond its immediate applications.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a xenotransplantation company engineering pig organs genetically compatible for human transplant.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company uses advanced gene editing to create pig organs with human-compatible immunology - ending the transplant waiting list crisis by providing an unlimited supply of genetically compatible donor organs.
quests.hint: Lead with ending the transplant waiting list crisis.
quests.explanation: Ending the transplant waiting list is the most urgent and morally compelling outcome in transplantation medicine.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a synthetic embryology company studying early human development for fertility and disease understanding.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company uses synthetic embryology to study the earliest stages of human development - understanding the events that determine healthy development and the origins of conditions that affect millions of pregnancies each year.
quests.hint: Lead with the origins of conditions affecting millions.
quests.explanation: Conditions affecting millions of pregnancies frames synthetic embryology as applied medicine rather than abstract research.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a global epistemic infrastructure company building shared truth-verification tools for information ecosystems.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company builds shared epistemic infrastructure - provenance verification fact-checking protocols and trusted source certification - that allows information ecosystems to distinguish reliable from unreliable knowledge at population scale.
quests.hint: Lead with population scale.
quests.explanation: Population scale distinguishes infrastructure from application and frames the ambition appropriately.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a civilisational memory archive preserving humanity's knowledge against catastrophic loss.
quests.correctAnswer: Our archive creates distributed redundant repositories of humanity's accumulated knowledge - ensuring that a catastrophic civilisational setback would not permanently erase the scientific cultural and practical knowledge that defines human achievement.
quests.hint: Lead with against permanent erasure.
quests.explanation: Against permanent erasure is the most serious possible framing of what civilisational memory preservation prevents.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a human potential research institute studying the upper limits of human flourishing and capability.
quests.correctAnswer: Our institute studies the upper limits of human flourishing - what the best achievable life looks like across the full range of human capacities - so that policy technology and culture can be directed toward achieving it more widely.
quests.hint: Lead with more widely achieved.
quests.explanation: More widely achieved is the equity framing that connects elite human potential research to universal human welfare.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a planetary defence coordination company preparing Earth for asteroid and comet impact risks.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company develops the technical and international coordination capacity for planetary defence - preparing humanity for the asteroid and comet impacts that have caused mass extinctions throughout Earth's history and will occur again.
quests.hint: Lead with the will occur again certainty.
quests.explanation: Will occur again certainty distinguishes planetary defence from speculative risk and frames preparation as rational.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a geoengineering governance research institute studying the ethics and politics of climate intervention.
quests.correctAnswer: Our institute studies the ethics science and international politics of climate geoengineering - preparing the governance frameworks and decision-making criteria that humanity will need before any large-scale intervention begins.
quests.hint: Lead with before any intervention begins.
quests.explanation: Before any intervention begins is the proactive governance timing that makes the research institute relevant now.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a synthetic consciousness research company studying the minimum conditions for moral status.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company studies the minimum conditions for moral status in natural and artificial systems - providing the philosophical and empirical foundation for the most consequential ethical decisions that advanced AI will require humanity to make.
quests.hint: Lead with the most consequential ethical decisions.
quests.explanation: Most consequential ethical decisions frames synthetic consciousness research as the intellectual prerequisite for AI governance.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a multi-civilisational dialogue platform facilitating long-term planning across cultural traditions.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform facilitates genuine dialogue between civilisational traditions about long-term human values - ensuring that decisions about the future of humanity reflect the full diversity of human wisdom not only the perspectives of currently dominant cultures.
quests.hint: Lead with the full diversity of human wisdom.
quests.explanation: Full diversity of human wisdom is the most inclusive possible framing of civilisational dialogue.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a transgenerational justice framework company developing enforceable rights for future generations.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company develops enforceable legal frameworks for transgenerational justice - giving future generations standing in current decisions through legal mechanisms that make long-term harm legally cognisable today.
quests.hint: Lead with legally cognisable today.
quests.explanation: Legally cognisable today is the practical legal mechanism that converts abstract concern for future generations into enforceable rights.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an existential hope research institute studying pathways to genuinely flourishing long-term futures.
quests.correctAnswer: Our institute studies not just what could go wrong for humanity but what could go profoundly right - developing the intellectual and practical roadmaps for futures that are not merely safe but genuinely excellent for every being capable of flourishing.
quests.hint: Lead with genuinely excellent not merely safe.
quests.explanation: Genuinely excellent rather than merely safe is the positive vision that makes existential research inspiring rather than terrifying.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a planetary consciousness project connecting global scientific artistic and spiritual traditions.
quests.correctAnswer: Our project connects scientists artists philosophers and spiritual leaders around the most profound questions about consciousness existence and meaning - building the cross-cultural intellectual foundation for decisions about the kind of civilisation humanity wants to create.
quests.hint: Lead with the kind of civilisation we want to create.
quests.explanation: The kind of civilisation we want to create is the ultimate framing for any project connecting humanity's deepest traditions.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a humanity-AI partnership institute developing mutual flourishing frameworks.
quests.correctAnswer: Our institute develops frameworks for genuine partnership between human and artificial intelligence - ensuring that as AI becomes more capable the relationship is characterised by mutual benefit and shared flourishing rather than domination in either direction.
quests.hint: Lead with mutual flourishing rather than domination.
quests.explanation: Mutual flourishing rather than domination is the relational frame that positions humanity-AI partnership as genuinely novel.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a post-scarcity transition advisory company helping societies navigate abundance without conflict.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company helps societies navigate the transition to post-scarcity conditions - the economic social and political redesign that will be necessary when automation makes material abundance universal but meaning purpose and belonging remain as scarce as ever.
quests.hint: Lead with meaning purpose and belonging remaining scarce.
quests.explanation: Meaning purpose and belonging remaining scarce is the insight that prevents post-scarcity optimism from being naive.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a deep time investment fund investing in returns measured in decades rather than quarters.
quests.correctAnswer: Our fund measures investment returns in decades rather than quarters - deploying capital into the patient long-horizon investments that are systematically underfinanced by quarterly-cycle capital markets despite generating the highest social and financial returns over time.
quests.hint: Lead with systematically underfinanced despite highest returns.
quests.explanation: Systematically underfinanced despite highest returns is the market failure that deep time investment corrects.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a civilisational antifragility company designing systems that grow stronger from disruption.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company designs civilisational systems that become stronger rather than weaker when disrupted - applying the principles of antifragility to critical infrastructure governance and human organisation so that adversity builds rather than destroys capability.
quests.hint: Lead with stronger rather than weaker from disruption.
quests.explanation: Stronger from disruption is the antifragility principle stated in the clearest possible terms.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a meaning economy research institute studying the economic value of purpose and connection.
quests.correctAnswer: Our institute studies the economics of meaning - quantifying how purpose connection and contribution generate the wellbeing and productivity that GDP fails to measure and that conventional economic policy consistently undermines.
quests.hint: Lead with what GDP fails to measure.
quests.explanation: What GDP fails to measure is the critique that gives meaning economy research both academic and political relevance.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a human civilisation continuity plan company preparing for multiple simultaneous catastrophic risks.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company develops and maintains a human civilisation continuity plan - the technical social and institutional preparations that would enable recovery from multiple simultaneous catastrophic events and preserve the accumulated knowledge and capability of human civilisation.
quests.hint: Lead with recovery from multiple simultaneous catastrophes.
quests.explanation: Multiple simultaneous catastrophes is the stress test scenario that makes continuity planning more serious than single-event preparedness.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a planetary intelligence company integrating all Earth observation data into unified situational awareness.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company integrates satellite sensor ocean buoy atmospheric and ecological data into a single unified planetary intelligence system - the real-time situational awareness of Earth's systems that humanity needs to manage the planet we have so profoundly altered.
quests.hint: Lead with the planet we have so profoundly altered.
quests.explanation: The planet we have so profoundly altered is the ethical framing that makes planetary intelligence a responsibility rather than an aspiration.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a post-human transition ethics company preparing frameworks for transformative capability enhancement.
quests.correctAnswer: Our company prepares ethical frameworks for the transformative capability enhancements that are coming - ensuring that cognitive augmentation genetic enhancement and AI integration are governed by principles of dignity equity and genuine human flourishing rather than technological inevitability and market dynamics.
quests.hint: Lead with rather than technological inevitability and market dynamics.
quests.explanation: Technological inevitability and market dynamics is the default that ethics frameworks must actively counter.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch the vision of a future where every problem in this curriculum has been solved.
quests.correctAnswer: Our vision is a world where conflict is resolved with wisdom resources are distributed with fairness disease is addressed with precision climate is managed with intelligence and every human being has the conditions to live a genuinely flourishing life - and the work that makes it possible is the work that English communication at its most ambitious can describe inspire and enable.
quests.hint: Lead with every human being having conditions for flourishing.
quests.explanation: Every human being with conditions for flourishing is the most inclusive possible expression of what an educated and capable world could achieve.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch why learning English opens doors to contributing to humanity's most important challenges.
quests.correctAnswer: Our conviction is that language is the technology that makes all other technologies possible - and learning English means joining the conversation where the world's most urgent problems are being named defined disputed and ultimately solved.
quests.hint: Lead with language as the technology that makes all others possible.
quests.explanation: Language as the technology underlying all others is the most profound possible argument for language learning.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch the final pitch: yourself as someone who has completed two hundred levels of English learning.
quests.correctAnswer: I have just completed two hundred levels of English communication practice - from describing a reusable coffee cup to articulating a vision for human civilisation - and I am ready to communicate in English with the precision empathy and sophistication that the world's most important conversations demand.
quests.hint: Lead with the full arc from the first level to the last.
quests.explanation: The full arc from coffee cup to civilisation is the most honest and moving testimony to what sustained English learning actually achieves.
